q: Hudson Taylor yatuuka atya ku kukkiriza, era nnyina yakolamu ki?
a: Ku lw'eggulo olw'okuwummulamu mu Juuni 1849, omuvubuka ow'emyaka kkumi na musanvu yayingira mu tterekero ly'ebitabo bya kitaawe, n'aggya akatabo k'Enjiri, era ebigambo "omulimu gwa Kristo ogwamalirizibwa" ne bimukwata — n'afukamira awo n'awaayo yekka eri Omulokozi. Ku ttuntu lwe lumu, ewala, nnyina yali yeggalidde mu kisenge, ng'asazeewo obutavaayo okutuusa ng'asabidde omwana we okuyingira mu bwakabaka, era ku nkomerero n'agolokoka ng'alina obukakafu obuteefu nti omulimu gwali guwedde. Bwe yadda eka, yasobola okubuulira Hudson olunaku n'essaawa yennyini lwe yakyukira, era okuddibwamu okwo kwe baagabana kwamulambika obulamu bwe bwonna.

q: Kiki ekyasika Taylor okwolekera China yennyini?
a: Nga tannazaalibwa, bazadde be baafukamira ne basabira omwana gwe baali balindirira nti: "Muwe okukuweerezanga mu China," okusaba kwe yamanya ng'amaze okukula. Kitaawe, omuMethodist eyakolanga eddagala mu Barnsley, yalina omugugu obulamu bwe bwonna olw'obukadde bw'abantu obutabalika mu China obwali tebunnawulira linnya lya Kristo, era oluvannyuma lw'okukyuka kwe ekirooto ekikadde eky'amaka ne kikomawo eri Hudson ng'okuyitibwa okunywevu. Yasaabala emmeeri okugenda mu China mu 1853, ng'aweza emyaka amakumi abiri mu gumu, n'ekibiina Chinese Evangelization Society.

q: Hudson Taylor ddala yayambalanga engoye z'Abachina, era lwaki kyaleeta empaka nnyingi?
a: Yee — mu myaka gye egy'olubereberye mu China yayambala engoye z'Abachina, n'amwa ekyenyi kye era n'asiba oluviiri lwe mu lukoba lw'Abachina, alyoke aggyewo buli kiziyiza ekitali kya bwetaavu wakati we n'abantu be yali azze okutuukako. Bangi ku baminsani banne baanyiiga, nga bakitwala ng'ekitasaanira kitiibwa kya Mulaaya, naye Taylor yali mwetegefu okufuuka Omuchina nga bwe kyakkirizibwa omuntu we ow'omunda asobole okuwangula Abachina. Kyafuuka akabonero k'obuminsani bwe yatandikawo oluvannyuma.

q: China Inland Mission yatandikibwawo etya mu 1865?
a: Mu maaso ga Taylor waali wanjuluddwayo maapu y'amasaza ag'omunda aga China abantu bonna gye baali bafa nga tebalina muminsani n'omu, naye n'atya obuvunaanyizibwa obw'okusaba abantu okugenda mu kifo gye yali tasobola kubasuubiza kintu kyonna okuggyako okubonaabona. Ekizibu kyakutuka ku Ssande, nga 25 June 1865, bwe yali atambula yekka ku musenyu e Brighton n'awaayo omugugu gwonna eri Katonda, ng'alowooza nti bwe kiba nti Katonda y'ayita abakozi era y'anaabakuuma, obuvunaanyizibwa bwali bwa Katonda. Ku lupapula olusooka olwa Bayibuli ye yawandiika nti: "Nasabira abakozi 24 abeetegefu era abakugu, e Brighton, June 25, 1865" — babiri ku buli ssaza eritaali lituukiddwako na babiri olwa Mongolia — era n'aggulawo akkawunti ya bbanka ey'obuminsani n'obupawundi kkumi.

q: Lwaki obuminsani tebwasaba muntu yenna ssente?
a: Taylor yateekawo ng'omusingi ogw'olubereberye nti China Inland Mission teyandiyingidde mu bbanja n'akatono era teyandisabye ssente wadde okwegayirira omuntu yenna; buli kyetaago kyandibuuliddwa Katonda yekka. Yali ayegezezza mu kwesiga kuno okumala emyaka mu Bungereza, omulundi gumu ng'agaba effeeza ye ey'enkomerero ey'ekitundu kya kkirawuni eri amaka agaali gafa enjala era n'afuna emirundi ena okusingawo mu ppoosita ey'enkya olwaddirira. "Omulimu gwa Katonda nga gukolebwa mu ngeri ya Katonda tegujja kubulwa ntereke ya Katonda," bwe yagamba, era okumala emyaka amakumi ana ssente zaatuukanga, emirundi mingi nga tezisabiddwa era emirundi mingi nga zituuka ku lunaku lwennyini olw'obwetaavu.

Nga 26 May 1866, Taylor, mukyala we Maria, abaana baabwe bana, n'ekibinja ky'abakozi abapya baasaabala okuva mu London ku meeri y'ebitambaala etwala caayi Lammermuir, ekibinja ekisinga obunene eky'abaminsani Abapolotesitanti ekyali kituuse mu China omulundi gumu. Olugendo olw'emyezi ena lwali kumpi okuzikirizibwa kibuyaga ow'amaanyi emirundi ebiri, naye ekibinja kyonna kyatuuka bulungi mu Shanghai mu Sebutemba eyo. Emirundi mingi kitwalibwa ng'enkyukakyuka mu mulimu gw'obuminsani mu kyasa eky'ekkumi n'omwenda, kubanga kyatwala abatandisi abaasooka ab'obuminsani obwali bukyali obuto mu nnimiro.

q: Bakyala ba Hudson Taylor baali baani, era nnaku ki ze yagumira?
a: Mu 1858 yawasa Maria Dyer, muwala wa muminsani eyalina amagezi ag'enjawulo n'okukkiriza okuwanvu, eyafuuka munne ow'amaanyi mu mirimu gye; abaana baabwe abato abawerako baaziikibwa mu ntaana ez'omu China, era mu 1870 Maria yennyini n'afa ng'aweza emyaka amakumi asatu mu esatu. Mu 1871 yawasa Jane Elizabeth "Jennie" Faulding, omu ku kibinja ekyasooka ekya Lammermuir, eyayimirira naye okumala emyaka egisukka mu amakumi asatu okutuusa lwe yafa olw'obulwadde bwa kookolo mu 1904. Taylor, ng'akooye era emirundi mingi ng'alwadde, teyakweka bwannamunigina n'okwennyamira okufiirwa kuno kwe kwamuleetera.

q: Taylor yategeeza ki bwe yayogera ku "bulamu obwawanyisibwa"?
a: Mu 1869, ng'akooye olw'okulwana n'okulemererwa, Taylor yakyusibwa ebbaluwa okuva eri munne John McCarthy eyamusonga eri okubeera mu Kristo, omuzabbibu, mu kifo ky'okufuba okwefunira obutukuvu. Yazuula ekiwummulo ekinywevu mu kwegatta n'okukolagana ne Kristo, ng'ategeera nti ettabi lirina kyokka okubeera mu muzabbibu era nti Kristo yennyini y'anaawa amaanyi omuweereza g'atalina. Nga bwe yakyogera: "Sirina kwefuula ttabi … Ndi kitundu kye era nnina okukikkiriza kyokka ne nkikolerako."

Yawandiika A Retrospect, ebyafaayo ebitonotono eby'okukyuka kwe n'emyaka gye egy'olubereberye n'engeri Katonda gye yakolagana naye, ebisise abasomi bangi mu kwewaayo eri obuminsani. Era yaleka Union and Communion, okufumiitiriza ku Luyimba lwa Sulemaani okwava mu bulamu bwe obw'omunda obwali bweyongedde okuziba, ne Separation and Service, ebirowoozo ebiggyiddwa mu kitabo ky'Okubala. Byonna birina omulamwa gumu: nti Kristo amala eri oyo amwesiga ddala.

q: Hudson Taylor yafa atya era wa?
a: Ng'anafuye era ng'akaddiye, yatandika olugendo olw'enkomerero okudda mu nsi gye yali awaddeyo obulamu bwe, n'atuuka mu China mu ttoggo lya 1905 era n'asitulwa ng'ayita mu masaza agaali gaggaddwa edda naye kaakano nga gajjuddemu amakanisa. Akawungeezi ka 3 June 1905 yafa mu bukkakkamu, awatali kulwanirira, e Changsha, ekibuga ekikulu ekya Hunan — ekibuga ekyali kimaze ebbanga ddene nga kigaana Enjiri era kaakano ne kimwaniriza. Yaziikibwa mu ttaka ery'omu China, mu bantu bazadde be be baasabira nga tannazaalibwa, ng'aleka obuminsani obwandigenze mu maaso okuyita mu kibiina ekyabusikira, OMF International ow'olwaleero.
